latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of lead-capture-ethical-bribe-design skill.

- Provides a structured process for designing lead-capture ads using a high-value ethical bribe to attract high-probability prospects.
- Helps users shift from direct-sell to lead-generation advertising, improving ad effectiveness by 1,233% via the 3/7/30/30/30 market readiness model.
- Guides users through confirming target market, identifying top pain points, brainstorming ethical bribe concepts, creating a lead-gen ad headline, designing a minimal capture form, and planning CRM follow-up.
- Produces a comprehensive lead-capture.md document for use in the 1-Page Marketing Plan canvas (square #4).
- Intended for small business owners, solopreneurs, entrepreneurs, freelancers, and startup founders at a beginner-to-intermediate level.
